english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on ambition and striving for advancement, especially in work or business.

exampleSentences.english: They are very enterprising at work and actively seek promotion every year.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢做嘢好進取，年年都主動爭取升職。

english.note: Use this for a person whose ambition is viewed positively as enterprising and self-improving.

exampleSentences.english: They’re ambitious and even study after work.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢好進取，放工後仲去讀書。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2 fong3 gung1 hau6 zung6 heoi3 duk6 syu1
